ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $ \triangle ABC$ is inscribed in a circle $\odot O$ with a radius of 6. Given $\sin\angle A=\frac{2}{3}$, what is the length of $BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Construct the diameter $CD$ of $\odot O$, and connect $BD$, hence $CD=2\times 6=12$.\\
$\therefore$ $\angle CBD=90^\circ$, $\angle D=\angle A$,\\
$\therefore$ $BC=CD\cdot \sin D=CD\cdot \sin A=12\times \frac{2}{3}=\boxed{8}$.
